decisions.title: Separate slow-growth node vs extending md.ts
decisions.rationale: Slow-growth has fundamentally different inputs (ICONST file, INCREM) and outputs (REPORT with free energy gradient) compared to standard MD. Dedicated node makes workflow graph more readable and parameter UI cleaner.

decisions.title: Constant-potential as shared param group
decisions.decision: Implement constant-potential (TPOT/CP-VASP) as a shared param_schema group importable by both md.ts and slow-growth.ts
decisions.rationale: Avoids duplication, consistent UI, allows constant-potential on both regular MD and slow-growth

decisions.title: Tool batch design for CatBot 15-round limit
decisions.decision: Design plan_research_project and create_batch_workflows as single-call batch tools
decisions.rationale: CatBot has 15-round tool loop limit. Full plan must return in 1 call, batch creation in 1 call.

decisions.title: Cation placement strategy
decisions.decision: Two placement modes: near-surface (2.5-4.0 Å from adsorbate COM) and bulk-water (>6 Å from surface, replacing a water molecule)
decisions.rationale: User needs to compare cation proximity effects. Near-surface = direct interaction, bulk-water = control condition.

decisions.title: Reuse existing MCP tools over writing new code
decisions.decision: Prioritize composing existing catgo_* MCP tools; only write new code where no existing tool covers the functionality
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested: '先使用已有的功能，调用mcp，如果无法实现，你再自己写'. Most structure building, VASP input gen, workflow creation already covered by 90+ existing tools.

decisions.title: Dual adsorbate placement as new tool
decisions.decision: Create catgo_place_dual_adsorbates tool with auto site pair selection and orientation
decisions.rationale: Existing catgo_adsorption_place can place one adsorbate at a time, but C-N coupling requires two adsorbates with controlled distance and facing orientation. This cannot be reliably composed from two sequential single-placement calls.

decisions.title: Remove all HPC file size limits
decisions.decision: Remove MAX_TEXT_FILE_SIZE (100 MB), MAX_BINARY_FILE_SIZE (50 MB), and default 2 MB text limit
decisions.rationale: User needs to visualize large VASP output files (XDATCAR, OUTCAR, vasprun.xml) from HPC without truncation.

decisions.title: Inline constant-potential params instead of shared module
decisions.decision: Keep constant-potential params inline in both slow-growth.ts and md.ts rather than extracting to a shared file
decisions.rationale: The two nodes have slightly different constant-potential params (md.ts includes tpot_electstep and cpvasp_nescheme, slow-growth uses tpot_fermi). Shared module would need complex conditional logic. Inline is simpler and each node's param_schema is self-contained.

decisions.title: Seed workflow templates at startup, don't overwrite existing
decisions.decision: Built-in templates are upserted on first startup only; if a template ID already exists, skip it
decisions.rationale: Users may customize templates after seeding. Re-seeding on every startup would overwrite their changes. Check by ID before inserting.
